headline: Running-frequency objective (3x/week) is the only one with two consecutive weeks of positive momentum; weight and protein tracking have gone dark simultaneously (6 and 3+ weeks respectively), which is now the dominant risk to the global comeback timeline, not physiology or training capacity.
athletic_profile_verdict: Masters-age (42y) endurance athlete, Mitchell Class IC (low static/high dynamic), ACSM 'Good' VO2max-running tier (42.4 ml/kg/min) for age/sex, in an evidence-based post-layoff rebuild below but recovering toward a documented sub-elite-amateur ceiling (1:34:33 half-marathon PR, 2019). Primary constraint is body mass/tissue tolerance carried over from the 2020-2025 volume collapse, not aerobic capacity.

objectives.title: Reprendre la course 3x/semaine
objectives.status_note: 2 consecutive weeks (W29, W30) at 3 runs/wk; W31 in progress at 2/3 with 3rd scheduled 08/02 per active_block.md. Gates objectives 9b982443 and 96910249.

objectives.title: Atteindre 160g de proteines/jour en moyenne
objectives.status_note: Complete nutrition-logging blackout 2026-07-10 through 2026-07-31 (0g/0 meals every day). Not a literal intake collapse -- an engagement problem, worsening. Shares failure mode with weight objective (218d1c78): both manually-logged, both dark since mid-July.
objectives.training_planner_relevance: low -- relevant to tissue-tolerance/recovery framing only if it resumes

objectives.title: Bilan sanguin complet annuel
objectives.status_note: Last full panel 2025-12-01/04 (7.9mo old). Embedded Vitamin D retest (due ~July 2026) now past its window, unresolved. No labs data would help disambiguate the weight-loss plateau.

objectives.title: Descendre a 95 kg
objectives.status_note: Withings sync stale 42 days (last reading 2026-06-20). Observed pace 0.197 kg/wk vs 0.40 kg/wk now required -- gap widening. Rate remains inside safe evidence-based range whenever measured; the risk is measurement/engagement, not physiological.
objectives.training_planner_relevance: medium -- higher bodyweight is the primary injury vector for descent/eccentric loading per active_block.md

objectives.title: Retour au niveau competiteur amateur (rollup: semi < 1h45, poids < 95kg)
objectives.status_note: Rolls up half-marathon (96910249), weight (218d1c78), gated by running-frequency (a1bde447). Physiologically on track (ACWR 1.06-1.12 this week, VO2max-running and RHR both improved this quarter); dominant risk is the simultaneous weight+protein logging blackout, not training capacity.

objectives.title: Courir jusqu'au Parc des Beaumonts (sortie 12 km)
objectives.status_note: 75.8% of baseline-target delta banked (Run #20, 2026-07-24, 10.5km). Attempt window W36 (~Sept 5-6), fallback W37, per active_block.md. Elevation reframe (D+ progressing on separate rung from distance) pending route recon W32-W33.
objectives.training_planner_relevance: primary driver of active_block.md long-run progression

objectives.title: Semi-marathon en moins de 1h45
objectives.status_note: No race scheduled. Fully gated by running-frequency and long-run objectives, both trending up. Strong historical precedent: 1:34:33 PR (2019-03-16), ~10min faster than target.
objectives.training_planner_relevance: downstream -- no direct planning input until a race is booked

coherence_notes: No physiological conflict: active_block.md deload weeks (W31, W35) protect running-frequency/long-run objectives without an unsafe ramp; no tension with weight-loss pacing at current load levels.
Protein (49829c29) and weight (218d1c78) share one likely root cause -- manual-logging disengagement starting mid-July -- rather than being independent problems.

Stalled labs objective (42361937) compounds the weight plateau: no current thyroid/testosterone/metabolic data exists to rule in/out a non-behavioral contributor at the moment the weight objective's required pace has overtaken its demonstrated pace.
The fully auto-tracked dependency chain (running-frequency -> long-run -> half-marathon -> global rollup) is the only one trending up two review cycles in a row.
highest_leverage_action: Land Run #23 this week (protects a 3rd consecutive 3-run/wk week -- the only objective with positive, physiologically-cleared momentum) and log one full day of nutrition intake before the next review cycle (near-zero cost, resolves 3+ weeks of measurement ambiguity on the weight/protein objectives).
